01 / THE INTRODUCTIONA little context, beyond the projects.
HELLO, I’M PUSHPIKA

Hi, I’m Pushpika.
I turn ideas into software.

I’m a software engineer with a background in Computer Engineering at the University of Peradeniya. I design and build web and mobile products, bringing the interface and the technology behind it together.

I like making complicated things easier to use. That starts with listening, asking questions, and understanding what people need. Then I build, test, and keep improving.
